contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns. RSpec specs use instance_double mocks for HTTP. YARD docs use standard @param, @return, @example, @raise tags.
key_patterns: Model specs mock Net::HTTP with instance_double and stub_http_streaming/stub_http_error helpers. Models include Base and StreamEventBuilder modules. Use build_stream_event helper for events. Spec structure: #initialize, #update_config, #get_config, #format_request (if public), #stream with contexts for success, tool calls, errors.
